lake-tekapo.quote: By car [ edit | edit source ] It is about 60 km north of Twizel on State Highway 8, the Central Southern Alps Highway , 2.5 hours south-west of Christchurch and three hours north of Queenstown .

east-cape.quote: Take State Highway 2 from Auckland , Tauranga or Wellington .

bay-of-islands.quote: By car [ edit | edit source ] State Highway 1 from Whangarei and Auckland runs through Kawakawa on its way to Kaitaia .

hokianga.quote: From Dargaville drive 54 km northwards on State Highway 12 (SH 12) past the Waipoua Forest info spot.

waipoua-forest.quote: The drive is roughly an hour from Dargaville or 20 minutes from Omapere.

lake-te-anau.quote: Turn off the Queenstown - Invercargill highway just north of Lumsden onto SH94.

coromandel-peninsula.quote: Thames , the gateway to the Coromandel, is located within an hour and a half drive of the major centres of Auckland (115 km) and Hamilton (107 km) and their airports, and yet the region is a world away from the hustle and bustle of those cities.

fox-glacier.quote: The drive from Franz Josef is about 30 minutes.
